authorship_and_authority.role: Dev technical input for Vaishnavi QA issue #41 and owner classification/coverage handoff.
authorship_and_authority.statement: Prepared through the development review workflow. This artifact does not sign Vaishnavi's report, record human QA acceptance, select a final submission build, or claim a fresh blind classification after published coverage rates.

review_scope.operations: Read repository/framework sources and retained evidence; inspect Git identities; compute hashes; parse Python ASTs; write only this supplemental JSON. No tests, Django setup, database operations, commit, push or external posting.

test_plan.unit: Django TestCase for models, forms and views of each module
test_plan.integration: views ↔ ORM ↔ MySQL, for example allocation transaction and constraints
test_plan.system: end-to-end flows from the browser using the test cases in Section 13

srs.requirement: Code follows PEP 8 and is split into separate Django apps per module; unit tests cover at least 70% of the application logic.

requirements_basis.interpretation: The original plan permits Django model/form/view components; it does not impose a universal no-database unit rule. Database fixtures, class names, test base classes, HTTP usage and transaction wrappers alone do not settle the asserted contract. Disclose actual dependencies separately.

historical_classification.source_scope_verbatim: All 190 methods discovered by the ordinary Django suite, across 19 test modules. Optional scripts/part3 browser/load/recovery harnesses are separately scoped and do not receive application-unit credit.
historical_classification.selection_core_hash_note: Retained original provenance value, not a newly invented serialization of the selection core. The two list hashes below are recomputed with their explicitly documented encoding.

conservative_component_methods.hash_encoding: Sort exact method IDs lexicographically, join with LF, append one final LF, encode UTF-8 without BOM; hash those bytes.

supplemental_scope_tags.isolated_application_helper: A focused helper contract exercised without database access; the exact HMS group below uses SimpleTestCase with no database opt-in.
supplemental_scope_tags.model_or_form_and_database: Direct model/form component contract with persistent fixtures, ORM validation or query evaluation; eligible for the original broad component interpretation, with dependencies disclosed.
supplemental_scope_tags.view_and_database: A focused route/form/view contract using Django request, authentication, ORM or template machinery; distinguish its asserted contract from all executed wiring.
supplemental_scope_tags.integration: An asserted persisted lifecycle, cross-component business reconciliation, audit integration, actual database constraint or rollback coordination. Existing historical labels are retained.
supplemental_scope_tags.concurrency: Parallel database operations with a race/locking outcome asserted; preserved as a separate historical category.
supplemental_scope_tags.system: Broad cross-module navigation/journey; disclose Django-client surrogate versus actual browser execution.
supplemental_scope_tags.tooling: Verification-runner and deployment/configuration checks outside the application-unit numerator.
supplemental_scope_tags.usage: These are explanatory tags for this targeted supplement, not a replacement classification of all 190 methods or an accepted unit selection.

isolated_hms_helper_group.static_basis: Each relevant top-level test class directly subclasses django.test.SimpleTestCase and has no databases opt-in; methods invoke parser, form-field or response helpers. Source/module totals are three form-field, ten request-parser and three response-helper methods.
isolated_hms_helper_group.limit: Identifies a concrete isolated helper group; it does not assert that these are the only possible isolated units in the full repository or that all 85 historical components are isolated.

rationale_corrections.historical_rationale_verbatim: Successful account form/view update persists user data through an audited transaction.
rationale_corrections.supplemental_asserted_scope_rationale: Successful account-update request checks the redirect and persisted first_name and role. The method does not assert AuditEvent contents or transaction rollback.
rationale_corrections.execution_disclosure: accounts/views.py update_user is transaction.atomic and calls record_event after a changed form saves. That executed audit path differs from audit behavior explicitly asserted by this method.

rationale_corrections.historical_rationale_verbatim: Successful staff HTTP registration persists a student through the audited form/view transaction.
rationale_corrections.supplemental_asserted_scope_rationale: A force-authenticated warden submits student registration; assertions check the redirect and existence of the created Student. The method does not assert AuditEvent contents or transaction rollback.
rationale_corrections.execution_disclosure: students/views.py student_create saves the Student and records an AuditEvent inside transaction.atomic. Auditing executes on the successful path but is not explicitly asserted here.

rationale_corrections.historical_rationale_verbatim: Two successful management writes perform hashed-password account creation and deactivation through audited view transactions.
rationale_corrections.supplemental_asserted_scope_rationale: Successful account creation checks the redirect and hashed-password verification; a subsequent deactivation request is followed by a persisted is_active assertion. AuditEvent contents and rollback are not asserted.
rationale_corrections.execution_disclosure: accounts/views.py user_management and deactivate_user execute audited transactions. The creation/deactivation lifecycle supports retaining the historical integration interpretation without describing audit behavior as asserted.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Student model deactivation consults Allocation even without an allocation fixture
other_execution_disclosures.fact: Student.save locks the existing Student row and checks for an active Allocation before saving inactive status. No active-allocation fixture does not establish absence of allocation interaction.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the historical component proposal as a coherent Student model contract; disclose the allocation query. This is not a new QA boundary candidate or a DB-free unit claim.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Room and owned Bed synchronization uses transactions and allocation-history relationships
other_execution_disclosures.fact: These methods persist/query Room and Bed rows. Room.save is atomic and synchronizes its owned Bed collection; its capacity-reduction path excludes beds with allocation history, even where the test creates no allocation fixture.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the historical hostels aggregate interpretation. State database/relationship execution facts; transaction use alone differs from an asserted rollback or concurrency contract.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: The student account picker asserts a real relational queryset
other_execution_disclosures.fact: StudentForm account choices are evaluated through User querysets and the linked student_profile relationship for create/edit fixtures.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the coherent form-component proposal under the original plan; do not describe it as isolated form logic.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Date-presentation method contexts include inline service fixture execution
other_execution_disclosures.fact: The method calls allocate, release, allocate and record_payment before requesting the self-service page and asserting rendered dates and the vacated-date fallback.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the presentation-component proposal. Service calls used as fixtures do not alone settle the asserted scope; their executed application lines remain inside the method context and cannot all be attributed to date assertions.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Unsaved Model.full_clean is not evidence of DB-free validation
other_execution_disclosures.fact: These methods call full model validation. The local Django Model.full_clean API defaults validate_unique=True and validate_constraints=True and continues eligible checks after field errors. An unsaved model or a field ValidationError does not establish that database validation was forbidden.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the direct model-component interpretation. Do not infer database-free execution or an application coverage contribution from the test names.

framework_reference.provenance: Local framework source inspected read-only; not part of the reviewed Git tree. No framework code was imported or executed for this review.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Account form invocation is not automatically isolated
other_execution_disclosures.fact: These direct ModelForm checks use real model instances or existing rows; form/model uniqueness checks can consult the database. StudentForm explicitly queries existing student IDs.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the form-component proposal; distinguish it from the isolated HMS helper group.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Rejected writes and audit non-effects already have disclosed alternatives
other_execution_disclosures.fact: These methods assert rejection/validation behavior and stored state or absence of audit updates. The first two are historical borderline primary components; the password-settings method is historical borderline integration.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Keep all historical flags, categories and selections. Apply one explicit QA boundary rule to these alternatives; no new borderline flag or selection is introduced here.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Application retention and audited admin persistence remain application checks
other_execution_disclosures.fact: Retention asserts actual eligible/retained AuditEvent rows and dry-run behavior. The admin-mixin method stubs the admin parent but persists User/Student objects and asserts actor/action AuditEvent rows.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain historical integration and existing borderline alternatives. A management-command entry point does not turn retention into tooling, and a stubbed parent does not remove the real cross-component persistence asserted by the mixin method.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: HMS system labels describe Django-client surrogates
other_execution_disclosures.fact: The three dashboard navigation methods and the allocation/payment/student/report journey use Django test clients; they do not launch a browser.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain the four historical system categories. Cite separately scoped browser evidence for the original plan browser-system requirement.

other_execution_disclosures.topic: Database environment checks and tooling are not isolated application units
other_execution_disclosures.fact: The four DatabaseConfigurationTests inspect the connected MySQL backend, session SQL modes, storage engines or ORM timezone lookup. The frozen tooling total separately consists of eight verification-runner methods plus one static-files configuration method.
other_execution_disclosures.recommendation: Retain historical categories; passing infrastructure/configuration checks alone establish no unit application-logic coverage. The pure static-files test remains tooling despite using SimpleTestCase.

limits: The 70% requirement concerns reviewed application logic, not the percentage or number of methods labeled unit/component.
Published full-file application coverage remains a proxy until QA/owners agree the application-logic denominator and attribution method.
Startup-inclusive standalone coverage mixes imports, declarations, shared fixtures, framework/database setup and teardown; it is not all credit for unit assertions.
Method contexts can include inline service/fixture work and import-order effects. Context execution does not establish which assertions validate every executed line.
Method and empty-context coverage overlap; do not add their counts without subtracting overlap.
Methods without measured application contexts retain their historical JUnit results but receive no inferred application coverage credit.
Neither existing mixed-suite rates nor the proposed standalone selection establish formal unit70 PASS or FAIL. No new unit passes, denominator change or coverage credit is claimed here.

qa_handoff.action: Retain the coherent Django component interpretation allowed by the original plan, disclose database/request execution and inline fixtures, and decide the two new candidates plus existing historical borderlines using one recorded boundary rule.
qa_handoff.later_changes: If QA accepts a different method boundary, publish a separately versioned decision and exact selected IDs with source/run/environment provenance. Do not overwrite the frozen proposal or reuse its measured subsets as measurements of a changed selection.

static_verification.candidate_filename_rule: Tracked Python files whose basename starts with test, excluding scripts/; all 19 match the original test-source path set. This is a static source check, not Django runtime discovery.
static_verification.ast_identity_rule: Top-level class direct test_ methods form module.class.method IDs; parse all 19 frozen source files without importing project/framework code.
